fields.v: Proposes an approach; secondary: Proposes an evaluation method — Cortex supervisory layer (pre-execution governance, requirement tracking, validation-repair loop), the authors' own product, formalised as a fixed-point model with conditional theorems; Gauntlet evaluation protocol (five task families, VERTEX and build-gated scores, ASR estimators), with historical raw-vs-governed pilot observations (June 2026) reported descriptively
fields.quote: We study Cortex, a supervisory layer for pre-execution governance, requirement tracking, and iterative validation and repair.
fields.why: The authors present and formalise their own tool (Cortex) and report raw-vs-Cortex pilot results, which fits 'Proposes an approach' better than 'Conceptual'; the record also scores Q3-Q8 (empirical only) and Q13, which is inconsistent with a purely conceptual nature.
fields.doubt: Os autores (Alpha Omega Labs) apresentam a sua própria ferramenta Cortex e reportam resultados de pilotos (secção 7, pág. 15-17). Isto parece 'Proposes an approach' e não 'Conceptual'. Além disso, deste Q3-Q8, que só se aplicam a estudos empíricos. Decide a natureza; se ficar 'Conceptual', Q3-Q8 deviam ser N/A.
